AuthorizedScope.description: The scope block of a ScopeAuthorization (spec 9.1). exclude always beats include (SEC-002); wildcards must not span a public suffix (SEC-003).

exclude.description: Hostname patterns explicitly out of scope; beats include (SEC-002).

valid_from.description: Start of validity window, RFC 3339 string; parsed and enforced by multiscan-scope (SEC-001). Kept as a string so multiscan-core stays chrono-free.

valid_until.description: End of validity window, RFC 3339 string; parsed and enforced by multiscan-scope (SEC-001).

authorized_by.description: Person or role granting the authorization.

attestation.description: Statement that written authorization is on file; must be non-empty (A-1, enforced by multiscan-scope).

signature.description: ed25519 signature over the authorization content.

ScopeAuthorization.description: Signed record permitting probing of named remote targets (spec 9.1). No flag, env var, or config key may bypass it (SEC-009).

scope.description: The authorized scope and validity window.
